cc:Work.dc:title: Normalized interior profile at L=160
cc:Work.dc:description: The limiting normalized profile is deformation-independent in the proved bulk domain. Markers are floating-point recurrence values at q=2.6 and q=3.5; finite-size corrections depend on q. Reflection uses i -> 161-i, with x=i/160. Point data and provenance: spatial_memory.json.
